style: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final horizontal 16:9 videogame store cover for a cohesive Spanish educational game collection. Input image 1 is the PRIMARY STYLE REFERENCE, the older WORD PLAY cover: follow its bold chunky sculpted title, colorful polished cartoon-fantasy game art, magical books, tangible letter tiles, expressive shapes and friendly premium videogame identity. Input image 2 is a supporting reference for fantasy charm, title hierarchy and colorful environments, NOT a requirement to copy its pixel-art technique. Create a NEW cover matching this collection, not a copy of either scene. Hand-painted illustrative cartoon fantasy, confident outlines, lively saturated colors, warm inviting lights, beautiful magical materials, slightly stylized 3D-volume title lettering. Avoid photorealism, cinematic realism, generic movie-poster seriousness and tiny typography. The EXACT GAME TITLE specified below must be huge, beautifully integrated as the centerpiece, thick beveled gold/cream and accent-color letters with dark outline, extremely legible at 360px thumbnail width. Center it in the upper-middle half, keep 8% safe margins, allow two or three lines for long titles; scenes frame the title from below and sides. No extra tagline, subtitle, label, watermark, franchise logo or interface. Text spelling and Spanish accents must be exact. Game-defining props should remain visible and foregrounded; clear composition, do not clutter.
